AlertDialog.description:
Confirmation for consequential actions. Unlike Dialog it does not close on outside click,
and initial focus lands on Cancel so Enter never confirms by accident.

props.name: onConfirm
props.description: Called when the user confirms. Return a promise to show a loading state until it settles.

props.name: tone
props.description: `danger` styles the confirm button as destructive and shows a warning icon.

props.name: trigger
props.description: Optional trigger element (e.g. `<Button variant="danger">Delete</Button>`).

getInitials.description: Up to two initials from a name: "Asha Rao" -> "AR", "northwind" -> "N".

Avatar.description: Circular avatar: image when available, initials otherwise (also the fallback if the image fails).

props.name: name
props.description: Full name; used for initials and as the accessible label.

props.name: decorative
props.description: Render as decorative (when the name is already shown next to it).

Badge.description: Compact label for status, category or count. Server-component safe.

props.name: dot
props.description: Leading status dot. Status must never rely on colour alone, so keep a text label.

props.name: icon
props.description: Leading icon (14px). Decorative; the label carries the meaning.

Button.description: The primary action control. Renders a native `<button type="button">` by default.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered before the label.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks. Focus is kept so screen readers announce the change.

props.name: touch
props.description: Grow to the 44px touch height below 768px, matching production. Default `true`.

props.name: trailingIcon
props.description: Icon rendered after the label.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. `primary` is the HeiGin near-black accent.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned actions (buttons, menus).

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level for the title. Default 3.

Card.description: White surface with hairline border and card shadow. Server-component safe.

props.name: interactive
props.description: Adds a hover shadow; use when the whole card is a link or button.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner padding. `none` lets tables and lists run edge to edge.

Checkbox.description: Checkbox built on Base UI. Supports `checked`, `defaultChecked`, `indeterminate` and `onCheckedChange`.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary text under the label.

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Omit only when the checkbox is labelled another way (e.g. `aria-label` in a table row).

Dialog.description: Root of a modal dialog. Accepts `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`.

DialogTrigger.description: Opens the dialog. Use `render={<Button />}` to render a HeiGin Button.

DialogClose.description: Closes the dialog. Use `render={<Button variant="secondary" />}` for a footer button.

DialogContent.description:
The modal surface. Traps focus, closes on Escape and outside click, restores focus to the
trigger on close, and locks page scroll while open.

props.name: title
props.description: Required: becomes the dialog's accessible name.

props.name: footer
props.description: Action buttons, rendered right-aligned at the bottom.

props.name: hideClose
props.description: Hide the top-right close button (Escape and the backdrop still close the dialog).

Drawer.description: Root of a drawer (a dialog that slides in from an edge). Accepts `open` / `onOpenChange`.

DrawerContent.description: Edge-anchored modal panel with the same focus management as Dialog.

props.name: side
props.description: `right` for record details and forms, `left` for mobile navigation, `bottom` for mobile sheets.

props.name: width
props.description: Override the panel width (right/left), e.g. "480px".

DropdownMenuSeparator.description: A thin divider between groups of items.

DropdownMenuGroup.description: Groups related items, optionally under a small heading.

props.name: label
props.description: Optional visible heading for the group.

DropdownMenu.description: Root of a dropdown menu. Controls `open` / `onOpenChange` when you need it controlled.

DropdownMenuTrigger.description:
The element that opens the menu. Pass `render={<Button variant="secondary" />}` to use a HeiGin
Button (or IconButton) as the trigger; otherwise renders a bare `<button>`.

DropdownMenuContent.description: The floating menu surface. Rendered in a portal, positioned against the trigger.

DropdownMenuItem.description: A menu action. Use `onClick` to handle selection; the menu closes afterwards.

props.name: shortcut
props.description: Keyboard shortcut hint shown on the right (display only).

EmptyState.description: Explains why a view is empty and what to do next. Server-component safe.

props.name: action
props.description: Primary next step, e.g. a Button.

props.name: size
props.description: `inline` for inside cards and tables, `page` for whole empty screens.

useField.description: Read the surrounding Field's ids and state. Returns `null` outside a Field.

useFieldControlProps.description: Merge Field-provided accessibility props with props set directly on a control.

Field.description:
Labels a single form control and wires up `id`, `aria-describedby`, `aria-invalid`,
`required` and `disabled` for HeiGin inputs placed inside it.

props.name: description
props.description: Helper text shown under the control.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. When set, the control is marked `aria-invalid` and the message is announced.

props.name: hideLabel
props.description: Visually hide the label (it stays available to assistive technology).

props.name: id
props.description: Override the generated control id.

IconButton.description: Square, icon-only button. `label` becomes the accessible name. Defaults to the `ghost` variant.

props.name: label
props.description: Required accessible name: icon-only controls have no visible text. Also shown as a native tooltip.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a spinner, sets `aria-busy` and ignores clicks. Focus is kept so screen readers announce the change.

props.name: touch
props.description: Grow to the 44px touch height below 768px, matching production. Default `true`.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual style. `primary` is the HeiGin near-black accent.

Input.description: Single-line text input. Inherits id, description and error wiring from a surrounding `Field`.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the control invalid without a Field. Inside a Field, pass `error` to the Field instead.

NativeSelect.description:
Native <select> with the input chrome — what production uses for filters ("All statuses")
and form fields (Owner). Best on mobile and for long, simple lists. Use Select for rich options.

Pagination.description: Previous/next pager with a live range label. Controlled.

props.name: page
props.description: 1-based current page.

props.name: formatRange
props.type: ((from: number, to: number, total: number) => string)
props.description: Formats the range label. Default: "1–20 of 134".

Popover.description: Root of a popover. Accepts `open`, `defaultOpen` and `onOpenChange`.

PopoverTrigger.description: Opens the popover. Use `render={<Button />}` to render a HeiGin Button.

PopoverClose.description: Closes the popover. Use `render={<Button />}` to render a HeiGin Button.

PopoverContent.description: Non-modal floating panel for small amounts of interactive content. Focus moves into it on open and returns on close.

RadioGroup.description: A labelled set of mutually exclusive options. Arrow keys move between options.

props.name: label
props.description: Group label, rendered as the accessible name.

SearchInput.description:
Controlled search field with a leading icon and a clear button.
Escape clears the value. Needs an accessible name: wrap it in a `Field` or pass `aria-label`.

props.name: clearLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the clear button.

props.name: onSearch
props.description: Called when the user presses Enter.

Select.description:
Single-value select with a custom listbox. Works inside a `Field` (label, description, error).
For long, searchable lists use a combobox instead.

props.name: name
props.description: Form field name; a hidden input is rendered for native form submission.

Skeleton.description:
Loading placeholder (production: surface-hover fill, pulse 1.4s). Decorative: announce loading
once on the container (e.g. `aria-busy` on the table) rather than on every skeleton.

props.name: shape
props.description: `circle` for avatars, `text` for a line of copy.

Spinner.description: Indeterminate loading indicator. Uses `currentColor`, so it inherits the text colour.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible label. Pass `null` when the spinner is decorative (e.g. inside a labelled button).

Switch.description: On/off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Built on Base UI (`role="switch"`).

props.name: label
props.description: Visible label. Without one, pass `aria-label`.

Table.description:
Generic data table: configurable columns, loading skeletons, empty state, row selection and
sortable headers. Sorting and pagination are controlled — the table never reorders data itself.

props.name: caption
props.description: Accessible table name. Rendered as a visually hidden caption unless `showCaption`.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Wrap the table in its own bordered surface, as production list pages do. Default `true`; pass `false` inside a Card.

props.name: bulkActions
props.description: Bulk actions bar: rendered above the table when rows are selected. Receives count and a clear callback.

props.name: empty
props.description: Rendered in place of rows when `rows` is empty and not loading.

props.name: getRowLabel
props.description: Label for a row's checkbox, e.g. (row) => `Select ${row.name}`.

props.name: loadingRows
props.description: Number of skeleton rows while loading.

props.name: onRowClick
props.description: Makes rows clickable (mouse) — always also provide a link or button in the row for keyboard users.

props.name: rowActions
props.description: Per-row action buttons/menus. Adds an actions column on the right.

props.name: selectedIds
props.description: Enables a checkbox column. Controlled.

Tabs.description: Root of a tab set. Accepts `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange`.

TabsList.description: The row of tabs. Arrow keys move between tabs; Home/End jump to the ends.

props.name: variant
props.description: `pill` (default) matches production record tabs and inbox filters. `underline` is a proposed extension for page-level sections.

props.name: count
props.description: Optional count shown after the label (e.g. unread items).

Textarea.description: Multi-line text input. Resizes vertically. Inherits wiring from a surrounding `Field`.

useToast.description:
Returns `toast(options)` and `dismiss(id?)`. Must be used inside `ToastProvider`.
Danger toasts are announced assertively; others politely.

ToastProvider.description: Mount once near the app root. Renders the toast viewport (bottom-right; bottom-centre on mobile).

props.name: limit
props.description: Maximum visible toasts. Default 3.

Tooltip.description:
Supplementary label shown on hover and keyboard focus. Escape dismisses it.
Wrap the app (or a region) in `TooltipProvider` to share delays between adjacent tooltips.

props.name: children
props.description: The trigger. Must be a single focusable element that accepts a ref (e.g. Button, IconButton).

props.name: content
props.description: Tooltip text. Keep it short; never put essential or interactive content in a tooltip.

props.name: delay
props.description: Delay before showing, in ms.

TooltipProvider.description: Optional provider that lets adjacent tooltips open instantly after the first one.

VisuallyHidden.description: Hides content visually while keeping it available to screen readers.

ActivityItem.description: One entry in a record's activity timeline. Use inside ActivityTimeline. Server-component safe.

props.name: children
props.description: One-line summary, e.g. "Meera S called Asha Rao".

props.name: dateTime
props.description: Machine-readable timestamp (ISO 8601).

props.name: icon
props.description: Icon for the activity type (call, WhatsApp, note, stage change...). Decorative.

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Display time, e.g. "2:40 pm" or "Yesterday".

props.name: detail
props.description: Optional body: message excerpt, note, or change details.

ActivityTimeline.description: Chronological record history (newest first). An ordered list, so position is announced.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name, e.g. "Activity for Asha Rao".

ApprovalCard.description:
An approval request: what, why, the change, and Approve / Reject. Records the outcome in place
and offers Undo when the action is reversible.

props.name: reason
props.description: Why it was proposed, in one sentence.

props.name: requestedBy
props.description: Who or what proposed it, e.g. "Agent · Receivable reminders" or "Meera S".

props.name: title
props.description: What needs approving, e.g. "Send reminder to Kaveri Textiles".

props.name: children
props.description: The draft itself (message, quote preview).

props.name: onUndo
props.description: Shown after a decision when undoable.

props.name: rung
props.description: When the proposer is the AI agent, its trust rung.

props.name: undoable
props.description: When false, approving cannot be undone (e.g. a sent WhatsApp message) — the card warns up front.

ChannelMark.description: Where a lead or conversation came from. WhatsApp green is a channel mark only, never a success colour.

props.name: display
props.description: `icon` shows only the icon, but keeps the channel name for assistive tech and as a tooltip.

ConversationListItem.description: One thread in the inbox list. Use inside a <ul>. Server-component safe.

props.name: href
props.description: Link to the thread. The whole row is clickable via a stretched link.

props.name: preview
props.description: Last message preview (plain text; truncated to one line).

props.name: timeLabel
props.description: Display time, e.g. "10:42 am".

props.name: aside
props.description: Extra trailing content, e.g. an SLAClock.

props.name: linkProps
props.description: Extra props for the row link (e.g. onClick for in-app selection, data attributes).

DealStage.description: Pipeline progress as segmented bars. Text conveys the position ("Stage 3 of 5: Proposal"). Server-component safe.

props.name: current
props.description: Current stage (must be in `stages`).

props.name: stages
props.description: Ordered pipeline stages.

props.name: compact
props.description: Hide stage labels (for table cells).

props.name: lost
props.description: Deal is closed-lost: the current segment turns red and the label says so.

DetailList.description:
Key/value facts for a record (production "Deal details" panel): 100px muted label column,
13px value, 12px row gap. A real <dl>, so pairs are announced together. Server-component safe.

props.name: labelWidth
props.description: Label column width. Production uses 100px.

FilterChip.description:
Quick filter. Two modes: a toggle (aria-pressed) for preset filters such as "Hot" or "Unassigned",
or a removable chip that shows an applied filter ("Owner: Meera S ×").

props.name: onRemove
props.description: Applied-filter chip: shows a remove button instead of toggling.

props.name: pressed
props.description: Toggle chip: pressed state. Omit `pressed` and pass `onRemove` for an applied-filter chip.

props.name: removeLabel
props.description: Accessible name for the remove button. Defaults to "Remove filter: <chip text>".

FilterToolbar.description: Search + quick filters + scope line for list pages.

props.name: actions
props.description: Right-aligned controls (view switcher, export).

props.name: chips
props.description: FilterChip elements.

props.name: scope
props.description: Scope disclosure, e.g. "Showing 24 of 61 · your leads". Announced politely when it changes.

MetricCard.description:
One KPI: label, value and hint. On its own it renders as a bordered surface; inside a
MetricGroup it becomes a cell of the production dashboard's single KPI strip. Server-component safe.

props.name: hint
props.description: Small context line under the value, e.g. "12 open deals".

props.name: icon
props.description: 14–15px Lucide icon shown before the label.

props.name: tone
props.description: Colour the value only when it needs attention (production: overdue tasks in danger).

props.name: trend
props.description: Optional change indicator. Direction is shown with an icon and words, not colour alone.

MetricGroup.description: Bordered KPI strip: MetricCards inside become divided cells. Server-component safe.

props.name: columns
props.description: Columns from 1024px up (2 below). Production dashboard uses 5.

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the group, e.g. "Pipeline summary".

MoneyValue.description: The only sanctioned way to render money: Indian grouping and tabular numerals. Server-component safe.

props.name: format
props.description: `full` = ₹8,49,600 · `compact` = ₹8.5L (full value exposed via title + accessible text).

PageHeader.description: Page title row: h1, one line of context, and the page's actions. Server-component safe.

props.name: actions
props.description: Primary and secondary page actions, right-aligned (wraps below on narrow screens).

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Pages use the default h1; pass 2 when embedding the header inside another page.

RecordHeader.description: Top of a record detail page: breadcrumbs, avatar, name, status, key facts and actions. Server-component safe.

props.name: name
props.description: Record name: person, company or deal.

props.name: level
props.description: Heading level. Detail pages use the default h1; pass 2 when embedding.

props.name: meta
props.description: Short facts: owner, value, location, channel.

props.name: status
props.description: Status next to the name (StatusBadge, TrustRungBadge).

SidebarNav.description:
App navigation rail content (place it inside your 240px sidebar, or a left Drawer on mobile).
Server-component safe unless you pass a client-only renderLink.

props.name: currentHref
props.description: `href` of the current page; gets aria-current="page".

props.name: label
props.description: Accessible name for the <nav>.

props.name: renderLink
props.description:
Custom link renderer for client-side routing, e.g. Next.js:
renderLink={(props) => <Link {...props} />}

SLAClock.description: First-reply SLA countdown. The state word and time carry meaning, not just colour. Server-component safe.

props.name: time
props.description: Human time string, e.g. "2h 10m left" or "20m over". Compute it in your app.

props.name: showLabel
props.description: Show the state word visibly (default hidden, still announced).

StatusBadge.description: Status = tint + ink + icon + word, never colour alone. Server-component safe.

props.name: hideIcon
props.description: Hide the icon in dense tables where the column header already gives context.

props.name: status
props.description: Registry key.

props.name: tone
props.description: Override or ad-hoc tone (prefer adding to the registry).

STATUS_REGISTRY.description:
Shared registry of named CRM statuses. Pages pass a key, never an ad-hoc colour.
Extend it here (or pass `tone` + `label`) rather than styling statuses locally.

TaskRow.description: A to-do in a list: complete checkbox, title, context, due date. Use inside a <ul>.

props.name: aside
props.description: Optional trailing slot (assignee avatar, menu).

props.name: context
props.description: Related record, e.g. "Kaveri Textiles · Asha Rao".

props.name: due
props.description: Due label, e.g. "Today, 4:00 pm".

props.name: onOpen
props.description: Opens the task. Rendered as the row's title button.

TrustRungBadge.description: The AI agent's autonomy level for a capability. Server-component safe.

props.name: showCode
props.description: Show "R2 · Act with review" instead of just the label.

TRUST_RUNGS.description: Canonical trust-ladder labels from the HeiGin product context. Use these words everywhere.
